svg.text: Each stage becomes a one-argument function with F.Bind1st(buildFullSearchBranch, stage). The two builder slices hold the prefix and fuzzy pair, and the token and phrase pair.

svg.text: A.Ap applies both stage builders to every field of a slice, so the 9 fuzzy branches follow the 9 prefix branches. A.From + A.Flatten joins the two groups into one 28-item slice.

text.font-family: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: appendFullSearchMergeBranch adds the merge text as a 29th queryBranch. A.Intersperse("\n") and A.Fold(S.Monoid) then join the 29 bodies into one statement.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One 532-line AQL statement: 28 LET search branches, then the merge tail.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The text is the same for every search; only the 14 bind parameters change. IO.Memoize builds it one time per process.
